messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error or the t-statistic? Actually they say "零假設檢定的標準差" which might refer to the standard error used in the t-test. So we need to compute the standard error: SE = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249; 1.4/6.3249=0.2213 approx. Then compute t-statistic: (sample_mean - population_mean)/SE = (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = (-0.4)/0.2213 = -1.807. Then degrees of freedom df = n-1 = 39. Then compute p-value two-tailed: using t distribution with df=39. For t=-1.807, p-value ~ 0.079? Let's approximate: t=1.807, df=39. Using t table: For df=40, t critical at alpha=0.05 two-tailed is 2.021. Our t=1.807 < 2.021 so p>0.05. Roughly p ~ 0.08. We can call the function to get exact p-value. Use two_tailed=true. Provide arguments: sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. Then get p-value. We'll use the function.
